results.title: Zahartzaro feministarantz, Boga-boga
results.overview: A Basque documentary that highlights the 30-year history and collective empowerment of Boga-Boga, a feminist group for older women in Ondarroa, Basque Country. It focuses on the voices and lived experiences of older women, proposing an active and collective view of aging.

results.title: The Children of Rustoord
results.overview: Heusdensebaan in Oisterwijk is now home to Hotel De Leyhof, but the site was once occupied by Rustoord Children’s Home. From 1927 onwards, the home provided shelter for children from families facing difficulties, for example when a parent had died or a mother was unable to care for all her children. The home was run by the Sisters of Charity. In 1975, Rustoord closed its doors.

results.title: The True Type
results.overview: In monumental frames, THE TRUE TYPE follows the image of the “ideal cow” across a Holstein cattle show, a 17th-century Dutch masterpiece, and the laser-guided robot arm of a milking robot. Three perspectives — breeding, art, and science —deconstruct the standards of perfection that have been built, painted, and judged for centuries.
